title: What the Crimean bridge attack means for Russia - DW.com
description: Ukraine's latest strike on the Kerch Bridge has disrupted a key transport link between Russia and Crimea. Beyond the damage, the attack could have serious consequences for Russian military logistics and Putin's prestige.

title: Sen. Cornyn blocks judicial nominee because Trump didn’t choose Texas - CNN
description: GOP Sen. John Cornyn is blocking President Donald Trump’s last-minute nomination of a senior Justice Department official for a federal judgeship as Republicans scramble to confirm Trump’s picks before the end of the year.

title: Cadillac F1 confirms Bottas for 2027, leaving Herta’s future uncertain - RACER - Racing News
description: Cadillac has confirmed Valtteri Bottas will retain his race seat in 2027, leaving Colton Herta facing an impasse in his attempts to race in Formula 1.
